facts.text: Dunk must help Ingrid get into Warwick's house and give Warwick the sleeping potion.
facts.possibly_moot: Sir Phidipaldi told Ingrid that Warwick knows about her night visits and is not interested, and she left crestfallen (beat_58, beat_60); Ingrid never released Dunk.

facts.text: Ingrid has been secretly visiting Warwick almost every night, and Sir Phidipaldi told her Warwick knows and is not interested, though Warwick himself never said so. Will she stop her night visits now?
